A '''stasis generator''' a device used to generate [[Stasis field/Legends|stasis fields]] and power multiple [[stasis booth]]s. [[Stars' End/Legends|Stars' End]] incorporated a massive stasis generator to control the thousands of booth installed to house its prison population.
